pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with predominantly rounded vertices and low-contrast, soft pixel gradients at the edges. Patch size is heterogeneous, with the largest spatial area concentrated on the central flank and smaller, more condensed geometries on the neck and lower torso.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-pelage network with high connectivity. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent. Path thickness is variable, showing increased pixel width in the ventral-lateral region compared to the cervical region.
